content: We validated the recorded eye-tracking data by analyzing the fixations made by all subjects through their reading speed and omission rate on sentence level. The omission rate is defined as the percentage of words that is not fixated in a sentence. Figure FIGREF10 (middle) shows the mean reading speed over all subjects, measured in seconds per sentence and Figure FIGREF10 (right) shows the mean omission rates aggregated over all subjects for each task. Clearly, the participants made less fixations during the task-specific reading, which lead to faster reading speed.
